subject: Next steps: Finsera trial success pathway & kickoff window
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@finsera.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Finsera discovery — proposed POC success pathway (recap + ask)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed, lightweight trial approach so we can align on outcomes and ownership: 

Summary of needs (from call)
- Evaluate Redwood inference for nightly batch document embeddings and a low-latency conversational assistant for internal ops.
- Security is a gating item (VPC + audit logs) and Finsera needs a SOC-2 checklist completed before we begin.
- Success metric: embeddings quality sufficient to return recommended docs in top-3 results for 80% of curated queries; conversational assistant 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 2k qps scenario.

Proposed POC (3-week, focused)
1) Week 0 (kickoff) — align environments, grant temporary access, baseline dataset ingestion (owner: Finsera eng / Rishi helps set up connectors).
2) Week 1 — run embedding job + validate retrieval results on 200 canonical queries (owner: Finsera + Monica for evaluation rubric).
3) Week 2 — integrate chat flow for ops use case, run load profile and latency tests (owner: Redwood infra + Finsera app).
4) Final readout — joint review of metrics, go/no-go decision and recommended roll plan.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm the team who will own data access and the SOC-2 contact?
- Are you available for a 30-min kickoff on Wednesday 12/2 or Thursday 12/3 (PST)?

I've attached a short runbook (POC_Runbook_v0.2) with checkpoints and sample evaluation rubrics. If this looks reasonable I'll send a brief mutual action plan to lock dates and owners.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Finsera_POC_Runbook_v0.2.pdf (outline), Mutual_Action_Plan_Finsera.xlsx (template)

Great summary. A couple of technical clarifications from our side so the kickoff can be productive: 

1) Data transfer: will you be comfortable with S3 presigned URLs for the initial 200-doc baseline, or do you require a VPC-only ingestion path from day 0? If it's the latter we should slot time during kickoff to confirm networking.
2) Query rubric: Monica, can you confirm the format you prefer for recording relevance judgments (CSV with columns: query, expected_doc_ids, score_{0-5})?
3) Load testing: to hit the 2k qps profile for latency we need an approximate payload size and token distribution — Samir, can you share a representative sample? Even a 10k-request sample will help us choose batching/instance sizing.

I can support the sandbox setup during Week 0 and will prepare a short infra checklist for the kickoff.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Thanks — locking Wed 12/2 10:00am PST for kickoff. Calendar invite sent. Agenda (30m):
- 5m introductions & roles (Finsera platform + security, Redwood infra + solutions)
- 10m runbook walk-through (Week 0 checklist + data access)
- 10m evaluation rubric & success metrics (Monica to lead)
- 5m next steps & action owners (Mutual Action Plan)

Quick answers to Rishi's points:
- Data transfer: Priya indicated SOC-2 constraints; we will plan for a VPC-only ingestion for production traffic. For the initial baseline (200 docs) Finsera is OK with an S3 presigned URL in the sandbox — we'll record the same controls in the runbook.
- Monica — CSV rubric format sounds good; I've attached an example CSV template in the Drive link.
- Samir — if you can drop a 1000-request sample payload to the shared Drive folder before EOD Tuesday, Rishi can run a sizing pass pre-kickoff.

Attachments referenced in invite: Finsera_POC_Runbook_v0.2.pdf (detailed checkpoints)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinseraPOC
DAP: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/SFR-88921 (I'll send the mutual action plan here after kickoff)

Looking forward to it.

—Vanessa
